messages:
Priya (support): Hey team — escalated from AcmeMaps. They see repeated partial SSE chunks when the client refreshes auth mid-stream. Customer using our Python SDK v0.9.3 (async iterator) to stream completions. They say reconnect produces duplicate tokens and occasional missing final token. Repro steps attached below. Billing concern raised: "double token" spike on their dashboard.

Alex Chen: Thanks Priya. Could you paste the raw request_id and any server logs? Also which model/variant and region?

Priya (support): request_id=rcpt_01G9TQJXYZ123, model=text-redwood-2.1, region=us-west-2. Raw logs: ``[2026-08-03T16:12:01Z] connection lost: 401 refresh_token_expired -> client reauth -> resumed stream, resumed_uid=rcpt_01G9TQJXYZ123, partial_chunk_seq=34
[2026-08-03T16:12:02Z] stream_resume: matched_prefix=true, kv_cache_hit=true, emitted_tokens=34, final_EOF_not_seen=true``

Maya Rivera: Interesting. We shipped a change in the iterator/polling logic in SDK v0.9.3 to optimize await_next() batching. It changed how EOF markers are detected when reconnect occurs. Could be a regression where the client replays buffered tokens on resume.

Jordan L: I can repro locally with a small harness. Repro steps I used: 1) start generator, 2) after ~200ms force token fetch, 3) revoke token (simulate 401), 4) reauth and call iterator.__anext__ again. Result: first resume returns last buffer + new tokens. Appears client returned cached tail then applied new increments. Minimal repro (Python):

```python
# repro.py
import asyncio
from redwood import StreamingClient

async def main():
    c = StreamingClient(api_key="temp")
    it = c.completions.stream({"model":"text-redwood-2.1","prompt":"say numbers 1..100"})
    # consume a few tokens
    for _ in range(10):
        t = await it.__anext__()
        print(t)
    # simulate auth error mid-stream and reauth
    c._simulate_401_for_test()
    await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
    # resume
    await c.refresh_key()
    try:
        while True:
            print(await it.__anext__())
    except StopAsyncIteration:
        pass

asyncio.run(main())
```

Priya (support): Customer logs show duplicated token strings like "42" appearing twice and a final chunk missing. They reported a spike in consumed tokens of ~1.7x for that stream window.

SRE-Bot: Observability note: between 2026-08-03T16:10 and 16:15 we had several short-lived auth errors from the identity proxy in us-west-2 (latency 120ms -> 502 retries). Correlates with customer timeframe. No infra-level streaming restart.

Alex Chen: Two hypotheses: 1) client replay of buffered tokens on resume (SDK bug), 2) server-side re-emit of last partial chunk on resume when KV cache is used (runtime fallback duplicating). We need to check whether token indexes (sequence numbers) are stable across resume.

Maya Rivera: I dug into SDK diff: in v0.9.3 we changed the async iterator state machine. The EOF sentinel used to be the single-line marker `\n__STREAM_EOF__\n`; we now rely on an internal flag from SSE event type. If a reconnect happens between SSE "data:" events, the client may treat the last incomplete event as unconfirmed and re-emit it after rejoin. That matches dup tokens. Also if final EOF is lost during auth failure, the iterator may never emit StopAsyncIteration -> missing final token.

Jordan L: I pushed a tiny repro-based patch to my branch that forces dedupe by token-id when resuming and treats absent EOF as transient until server confirms final. Local runs reduced duplicates. Patch: add per-stream last_token_id and on resume drop any token with id <= last_token_id.

Alex Chen: Good. Two-prong plan: (A) quick hotfix in SDK v0.9.4 to restore robust EOF detection and last-token-id dedupe; (B) runtime-side defensive: when serving resume requests, include explicit resume_ack with last_seq number to avoid the client guessing. Can we push SDK patch to 0.9.4 candidate?

Maya Rivera: I'll cut 0.9.4 branch with revert+dedupe changes, add unit tests for auth mid-stream. Also adding an integration test that simulates 401 midstream in CI harness.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: staging/sdk-0.9.4-candidate -> staging (tests running) :rocket:

Priya (support): For the customer: asked for a short-term mitigation: 1) ask them to use disable_auto_reconnect=true in SDK to force manual resume while we patch, 2) refund/bill-adjust for duplicated token window. Legal asked for quantified spike; I requested detailed token timestamps from AcmeMaps.

SRE-Bot: No evidence of double-emission from runtime for that request_id. Traces show one stream instance; duplicate tokens likely client-side.

Jordan L: After the patch, I ran client against a flaky proxy (simulating 401) and confirmed duplicates gone. Will open PR and link CI. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/pull/5823

Alex Chen: Once PR merges, let's coordinate a staged rollout and notify CS to offer patch + billing credit. Also add a monitoring alert for token-rate-anomalies per-customer to auto-detect similar spikes.

Priya (support): Thanks everyone — I'll update the customer with the timeline and the workaround. Follow-up: include steps to repro and link to PR in the ticket. :triage:
